title: Concept
description: Data about a concept that can be used to query a dataset

createdUserId.description: The user that created the resource

createdDt.description: The created datetime of the resource

updatedUserId.description: The user that last updated the resource

updatedDt.description: The datetime the resource was last updated

threshold.description: Threshold above which classification is positive

regularization.description: How strongly the model adapts to the training labels. Regularization strength. Lower value means the model fits more heavily to the training data

conceptId.description: The unique identifier for the concept

datasetId.description: The unique identifier for the dataset
